scope.purpose: Worked example of the three mapping-evidence states for a crosswalk field. Demonstrates the format only. It asserts nothing about any system other than the one that emitted the artifact.
scope.artifact_provenance: Emitted 2026-07-26 by agent-passport-system createDelegation() at the version pinned below. Ephemeral test keys, never used anywhere. Not a production delegation.
scope.claim_boundary: The three states below describe what THIS artifact carries. They are not claims about what the APS protocol can express, nor about any other system.

mapping_evidence.basis: Emitted directly as a signed field. A verifier reads it without computing anything.

mapping_evidence.inference_basis: Derivable as spendLimit minus spentAmount. The artifact never asserts the difference, so the value is a consumer's computation rather than the issuer's claim. If the issuer's accounting and the consumer's arithmetic disagree, nothing in the signed body resolves it.
mapping_evidence.why_not_absent: Both operands are present and signed, so the value is recoverable without any additional lookup.

mapping_evidence.no_mapping_rationale: Neither carried nor derivable. Revocation is a separate lookup against issuer state at verification time. A consumer holding only this artifact cannot distinguish an active delegation from one revoked one second after issuance.
